apps.tinyDescription: Make cards. Keep them exact. Study without limits.

screenshots.alt: Open Flashcards study screen showing a revealed answer and Know and Again controls
screenshots.caption: Study, reveal, know or try again.

screenshots.alt: Open Flashcards deck list with local card counts
screenshots.caption: Local decks with no card limit.

screenshots.alt: Open Flashcards card editor for exact front and back text
screenshots.caption: Your text stays exactly yours.

video.label: 35-second device check
video.description: This is the submitted build: launch, resume an interrupted study session, reveal, mark the card known, and finish.

fixes.quote: The app glitched and deleted them all.
fixes.fix: Saves every edit locally and keeps a previous-good snapshot for recovery.

fixes.quote: AI changing the content.
fixes.fix: Keeps the exact text you type or import. There is no AI rewriting path.

fixes.quote: Keeps rejecting my CSV files.
fixes.fix: Imports and exports ordinary CSV, preserving quoted commas, quotation marks and line breaks.

fixes.quote: A limit on how many cards you can use.
fixes.fix: Includes unlimited cards and unrestricted study for free. No ads, subscription or unlock.

fixes.quote: Finish a whole deck before it logs your progress.
fixes.fix: Restores the same study queue, prompt side and remaining count after interruption or relaunch.

fixes.quote: You can’t shuffle the cards.
fixes.fix: Lets you study in original or shuffled order, with fronts or backs as prompts.

fixes.quote: Forced to create a deck before I create a card.
fixes.fix: Starts the first card immediately in My Cards, while still supporting named decks.

apps.reviewLine: We read 6,978 App Store reviews of 14 flashcard apps. These complaints kept coming up.

apps.tinyDescription: Follow any site. Read means read. Your feed list stays yours.

screenshots.alt: Open Feeds list with unread counts for each followed site
screenshots.caption: Every feed, with an honest unread count.

screenshots.alt: Open Feeds All Unread headlines, with two read headlines laid flat
screenshots.caption: Scroll past it and it’s read.

screenshots.alt: Open Feeds Add Feed screen browsing popular feeds by topic
screenshots.caption: Browse checked feeds or paste any site.

video.label: 60-second device check
video.description: On a real iPhone: launch from the Home Screen, open All Unread, read an article and watch the unread count drop, then browse popular feeds.

fixes.quote: lost all of the feeds I had spent years curating
fixes.fix: Saves your list of feeds as an ordinary OPML file in Files after every change, and recovers from it.

fixes.quote: I’m constantly seeing things I’ve already read
fixes.fix: Read headlines stay read. A refresh never brings them back as unread.

fixes.quote: Unable to mark as read while scrolling
fixes.fix: Marks headlines read as you scroll past them. You can turn that off.

fixes.quote: Mark as Read requires at least 2 presses
fixes.fix: Mark All Read clears the list in one tap, with Undo.

fixes.quote: Only 10 feeds max allowed on free version
fixes.fix: Follow as many feeds as you like, free. No subscription or unlock.

fixes.quote: Can’t add any new feeds unless you know the exact RSS URL
fixes.fix: Paste any site’s address and it finds the feed, or browse about 270 checked popular feeds.

fixes.quote: takes me back to the login screen
fixes.fix: No account. Nothing to sign in to, ever.

fixes.quote: The app loads with about 20 feeds you never asked for
fixes.fix: Starts empty. Nothing is followed until you choose it.

apps.reviewLine: We read 8,959 App Store reviews of 12 feed and news readers. These complaints kept coming up.

apps.tinyDescription: Read your own EPUB, PDF and comics. Your books stay files.

screenshots.alt: Open Reader library with What's different and Continue reading
screenshots.caption: Your books, as plain files you can see.

screenshots.alt: Open Reader reading a public-domain chapter with the page bar showing Saved
screenshots.caption: Your page is saved on every turn.

screenshots.alt: Open Reader Type sheet with size, line spacing, paragraph spacing and margins
screenshots.caption: 14 sizes, spacing and margins.

video.label: 34-second device check
video.description: On a real iPhone at 2x speed: launch from the Home Screen, keep reading where you stopped, turn pages, open Contents, make the text bigger, relaunch and land on the same page.

fixes.quote: it deleted every single book that I had downloaded and all my reading data
fixes.fix: Books are copied, unchanged, into a folder you can see in Files. The app never moves or rewrites them.

fixes.quote: these downloaded books get offloaded to icloud or something, so I can’t read them without downloading
fixes.fix: Nothing is offloaded. Every book stays on your iPhone.

fixes.quote: Doesn't auto-bookmark your book upon closing
fixes.fix: Your page is saved on every page turn and comes back when you reopen the app.

fixes.quote: the font choices are still "too big" and "too small". And it's still impossible to turn off full justification
fixes.fix: 14 text sizes, and justification is off unless you turn it on.

fixes.quote: you can adjust line hight, but not the space between paragraphs
fixes.fix: Line spacing, paragraph spacing and margins each have their own control.

fixes.quote: the free version won’t read CBZ files until you try to read them and then it prompts you to buy their paid subscription
fixes.fix: EPUB, PDF and CBZ comics all open in this version, with no purchase.

fixes.quote: ads that show up while you are turning pages in a book
fixes.fix: No ads in this version.

fixes.quote: there is no way to bulk import books, you have to add them one at a time
fixes.fix: Pick many files, or a whole folder, at once.

apps.reviewLine: We read 6,760 App Store reviews of 11 ebook and comic readers. These complaints kept coming up.

apps.tinyDescription: Guitar, 12-string, uke, banjo and bass. 28 tunings, all included.
apps.reviewLine: We read 16,437 App Store reviews of 18 tuner apps. These complaints kept coming up.

screenshots.alt: Open Tuner on guitar, low E nearly in tune, with What's different
screenshots.caption: Tap a peg. Pluck. Tune.

screenshots.alt: Banjo string two semitones high: Too high. Loosen, don't tighten.
screenshots.caption: Sharp? It says loosen.

screenshots.alt: 12-string headstock with twelve pegs, octave string selected
screenshots.caption: 12-string, one string at a time.

video.label: 28-second device check
video.description: On a real iPhone, with sound: launch from the Home Screen, play E2, read the low E string live, hold Play to repeat the note, switch strings, then the 12-string and bass.

fixes.quote: it broke one of my strings becuase it kept telling me to tune up
fixes.fix: Shows the note it hears, says loosen when you're sharp, and never says tighten when it isn't sure.

fixes.quote: any alternative like drop D or half step down will require a subscription
fixes.fix: All 28 tunings across five instruments are included.

fixes.quote: Now there are 11 stupid questions before you can even use it.
fixes.fix: Opens straight to the tuner.

fixes.quote: pop-up ads that cover the whole screen each time you open the app
fixes.fix: No ads.

fixes.quote: automatically moves to the next one. You’re constantly selecting the string you want
fixes.fix: You pick the string. Auto never moves on by itself.

fixes.quote: this app has no option for 12-string guitars
fixes.fix: 12-string, each pair tuned one string at a time.
